sentences.en: Hello, this is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 你好,这是6分钟英语 从英国广播公司学习英语。

sentences.en: I'm Neil. And I'm Beth. It smells delicious sizzling in oil and it's great for keeping vampires away, but don't eat it on a first date!
sentences.zh: 我是尼尔,我是贝丝 闻起来很香,很香,但别第一次约会就吃!

sentences.en: I'm talking, of course, about garlic. Neil, do you like garlic?
sentences.zh: 我当然在说大蒜 尼尔 你喜欢大蒜吗?

sentences.en: Oh yes, I love garlic. I had a very garlicky meal last night.
sentences.zh: 哦,是的,我喜欢大蒜,我昨晚吃了一顿大蒜

sentences.en: Mmm, I know – I can smell it from here! Here is Jason Chan, an Australian chef who specialises in Asian cuisine, and Poul Erik Jensen, a Danish chef living in France, talking about their love of garlic to BBC World Service programme, The Food Chain:
sentences.zh: 嗯,我知道——我从这里就能闻到。这是杰森·陈,一位澳大利亚厨师,专门研究亚洲烹饪,还有波尔·埃里克·詹森,一位住在法国的丹麦厨师,他向英国广播公司世界服务节目《食物链》讲述了他们对大蒜的热爱:

sentences.en: I love garlic because it's a versatile ingredient that can be used for cooking and offers various health benefits.
sentences.zh: 我爱大蒜 因为它是一种多用途的成分 可以用来做饭 并提供各种健康福利。

sentences.en: We use it a lot and so from stocks to soups – and in vegetable dishes, meat dishes – there's very certain a clove of garlic in somewhere.
sentences.zh: 我们经常使用它,从股票到汤 — — 在蔬菜菜盘、肉盘中 — — 某处确实有一片大蒜。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's unimaginable not using garlic.
sentences.zh: 是啊,这是难以想象 不使用大蒜。

sentences.en: Jason loves garlic because it's versatile, meaning it can be used in many different ways.
sentences.zh: 杰森喜欢大蒜 因为它是多用途的 意思是它可以用很多不同的方式使用

sentences.en: And Poul thinks cooking without garlic is unimaginable, meaning it's difficult to imagine because it would be so bad.
sentences.zh: 而Poul认为没有大蒜做饭是难以想象的, 意思是很难想象,因为它会很糟。

sentences.en: Love garlic or hate it, in this episode we'll be finding out more about this versatile, strong-smelling food.
sentences.zh: 爱大蒜或讨厌大蒜, 在这个插曲中,我们会发现更多 关于这种多用途的, 强烈的熔炼食品。

sentences.en: And, as usual, we'll be learning some useful new words and phrases as well.
sentences.zh: 和往常一样,我们也会学习一些有用的新词句

sentences.en: And remember – you can find all the vocabulary from this episode on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 记住,你可以在我们的网站上找到这集里的所有词汇,bbc学习英语。com。

sentences.en: Now, Beth, I have a question for you. It's a little-known fact that of the 600 varieties of garlic, many grew only in the former Soviet Union and were unavailable in the West until the fall of communism in the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 现在,贝丝,我有一个问题要问你。一个鲜为人知的事实是,在600种大蒜中,许多大蒜只生长在前苏联,在西方,直到20世纪90年代共产主义的垮台。

sentences.en: So, which of the following varieties of garlic grew in the former USSR?
sentences.zh: 那么,以下哪一种大蒜在前苏联生长?

sentences.en: Is it: a) rocambole, b) fire, or c) riesig?
sentences.zh: 是:(a)罗坎波,(b)火,还是(c)瑞希?

sentences.en: Oh, I have no idea. I'm going to guess fire.
sentences.zh: 哦,我不知道,我会猜火。

sentences.en: OK. We'll find out if you're right at the end of the programme.
sentences.zh: 好,我们会发现你是否在节目的结尾

sentences.en: Garlic is much more than just a cooking ingredient.
sentences.zh: 大蒜不仅仅是烹饪的原料

sentences.en: For centuries, garlic was an important food throughout ancient Egypt, Greece and Rome, as well as India and China.
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来,大蒜是古埃及、希腊和罗马以及印度和中国的重要食物。

sentences.en: It was the Roman Empire that brought garlic to European countries like France.
sentences.zh: 是罗马帝国把大蒜带到了像法国这样的欧洲国家。

sentences.en: And everywhere garlic grew, it was praised for its health-giving powers.
sentences.zh: 大蒜生长的每一处 都被赞美 因为它的健康能力。

sentences.en: Here, BBC presenter Rumella Dasgupta asks author and garlic expert Robin Cherry about garlic's medicinal uses, on BBC World Service's The Food Chain: And what kind of illnesses or conditions would they have treated, for instance?
sentences.zh: 英国广播公司主持人Rumella Dasgupta在英国广播公司世界服务社的《食物链:他们会治疗什么样的疾病或病情》中询问作者和大蒜专家Robin Cherry关于大蒜的药用?

sentences.en: Everything from cancer, scurvy, the plague, respiratory ailments … it was used as an aphrodisiac.
sentences.zh: 癌症、腐烂、瘟疫、呼吸道疾病 都被用作春药

sentences.en: Garlic was used to treat respiratory ailments.
sentences.zh: 大蒜用来治疗呼吸道疾病。

sentences.en: An ailment is another word for an illness or minor health problem, so a respiratory ailment is an illness of the lungs.
sentences.zh: 疾病是疾病或轻微健康问题的另一个词,因此呼吸道疾病是肺部疾病。

sentences.en: In Ancient Greece, garlic was also used as an aphrodisiac – a food or drink believed to increase sexual desire.
sentences.zh: 在古希腊,大蒜还被用作春药 — — 一种食品或饮料,被认为会增加性欲。

sentences.en: But interestingly, this was the same reason why some cultures avoided eating garlic altogether, including a religious group from India called Jains.
sentences.zh: 但有趣的是,这也是为什么一些文化 完全避免吃大蒜的原因, 包括印度的一个叫Jains的宗教团体。

sentences.en: Yes, Jainism is an ancient Indian religion, like Hinduism and Buddhism, based on the idea of 'ahimsa', or non-violence.
sentences.zh: 是的,Jainism是一个古老的印度宗教,像印度教和佛教一样,基于“ahimsa”或非暴力的思想。

sentences.en: But unlike many Hindus and Buddhists, Jains' definition of non-violence includes plants and vegetables.
sentences.zh: 但与许多印度教徒和佛教徒不同,Jains对非暴力的定义包括植物和蔬菜。

sentences.en: Jains don't eat garlic because uprooting the plant kills both it and the soil ecosystem it grows in.
sentences.zh: Jains不吃大蒜 因为根拔的植物会杀死它 以及它生长的土壤生态系统

sentences.en: Here's Sonal Ved, a Mumbai-based cooking-show host and author of many books on Indian cuisine, explaining another reason why Jains avoid garlic to BBC World Service programme, The Food Chain:
sentences.zh: 这是Sonal Ved, 孟买的烹饪节目主持人,

sentences.en: According to Hinduism also, garlic is considered a food which is called a 'tamasic' food.
sentences.zh: 根据印度教,大蒜也被认为是一种叫做“塔马西克”的食品。

sentences.en: It is believed to stimulate desire, passion, aggression.
sentences.zh: 相信它会激发欲望、激情和侵略。

sentences.en: And that's why they abstain from eating those kinds of food: because it is believed to impact your spiritual growth and also your mental clarity.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他们不吃这种食物: 因为人们相信它会影响你的精神成长, 也影响你的精神清醒。

sentences.en: Jains abstain from eating garlic. If you abstain from doing something, you choose not to do it.
sentences.zh: Jains不吃大蒜 如果你不做点什么 你选择不做

sentences.en: For example, you might abstain from tobacco or alcohol because you know they're bad for your health.
sentences.zh: 比如说,你可能会戒烟或戒酒 因为你知道烟或戒酒有害健康

sentences.en: Like the Ancient Greeks, Jains believe that garlic stimulates sexual desire.
sentences.zh: 和古希腊人一样 Jains认为大蒜能刺激性欲

sentences.en: The verb to stimulate means encourage it or cause it to develop and grow.
sentences.zh: 刺激的动词意味着鼓励它或促使它发展和成长。

sentences.en: Modern medicine has confirmed some of these ancient beliefs about the health benefits of garlic, including reduced blood pressure and better gut health.
sentences.zh: 现代医学证实了这些古老的信念 关于大蒜的健康好处, 包括降低血压 和更好的肠胃健康。

sentences.en: OK Neil, isn't it time you revealed the answer to your question?
sentences.zh: 好吧,尼尔,是不是该你 透露你的问题的答案?

sentences.en: Yes, Beth. I asked you which variety of garlic grew in the former USSR.
sentences.zh: 是的,贝丝,我问你 前苏联有哪种大蒜生长

sentences.en: And I said fire. Was I right? You were absolutely correct.
sentences.zh: 我说了"火" 我说的对吗?

sentences.en: Yay! Fire or Georgian fire is a hot, white garlic from the Republic of Georgia in the former Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 火或格鲁吉亚火 是来自前苏联格鲁吉亚共和国的热白色大蒜

sentences.en: OK, let's recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with versatile, an adjective meaning to have many different purposes or uses.
sentences.zh: 好吧,让我们回顾一下我们学到的词汇, 从多才多艺开始, 一个形容词的意思 有很多不同的目的或用途。

sentences.en: The phrase, it's unimaginable is used to say that something is difficult to imagine because it would be so good or so bad.
sentences.zh: 这个词,这是无法想象的 用来说,有些事情是难以想象的 因为它会是如此好或如此糟糕。

sentences.en: An ailment is an illness or health problem.
sentences.zh: 疾病是疾病或健康问题。

sentences.en: An aphrodisiac is a food or drink believed to increase sexual desire.
sentences.zh: 春药是一种食物或饮料,被认为会增加性欲。

sentences.en: If you abstain from something, you choose not to do it.
sentences.zh: 如果你从某事弃权, 你选择不这样做。

sentences.en: And finally, to stimulate means to encourage something or cause it to grow.
sentences.zh: 最后,刺激鼓励某事或导致其成长的手段。

sentences.en: Once again, our six minutes are up. If you've enjoyed this episode then head over to our website, bbclearningenglish.com, where you'll find a quiz and worksheet to practise the vocabulary you've learnt.
sentences.zh: 再说一遍,我们六分钟就结束了。如果你喜欢这集,那就去我们的网站,bbclearingenglish.com, 在那里你会找到一个测验和工作表来练习你学到的词汇。

sentences.en: See you again soon. But for now, it's goodbye!
sentences.zh: 很快再见,但现在再见了!

sentences.en: Goodbye!
sentences.zh: 再见!
